q15_roll_call.title: Roll Call
q15_roll_call._comment: RV. C5 clue + creatures-were-people. Cond rv_roll_call (flag rv_mimic_killed set on mimic death, needs clue_survey_tag or a colonist death).

face.text: A dead mimic wears a face you buried. It knew the door code.

effects.title: Roll call
effects.text: Roll call: 11 present, 10 alive. It knew the door code.

count.text: It had a number. It is in our ledger. Everyone counted again.

bury.label: Bury it as an inmate
bury.text: A name goes on the stone. The Zealots stand watch.

burn.label: Burn it with the waste
burn.text: The smoke goes up with the rest. The Informant takes notes.

report.label: Send the tag to the Warden
